issues.description: The solution repository's Bitmap24 class header declares a default constructor (Bitmap24()), and client code (main.cpp) in the solution creates a Bitmap24 object with the default constructor (Bitmap24 bitmap;). However the solution's Bitmap24.cpp explicitly removed the default constructor implementation (comment: "Default constructor removed") while still providing the parameterized constructor. This creates a structural mismatch between the header/usage and the source: the declared default constructor has no definition, so the program will fail to link. Students following the solution (or trying to compile it) will encounter a linker error and be confused whether the default ctor is intended to be present or omitted.
